itemdesc-weatherglass: A brass barometer. Right-click to read pressure, trend and forecast. Pressure falls before squalls.
itemdesc-windvane: Right-click to read the wind: direction, strength in knots and Beaufort force.
itemdesc-anchor: Right-click while riding a sailboat to drop or raise the anchor. Drags in gales.
itemdesc-logbook: Right-click to read your sailing record: distance, squalls and temporal storms survived.
itemdesc-compass: Right-click for a full sailing report: wind, sea state, point of sail, sail and hull condition. Spins in temporal storms.
itemdesc-riggingline: Right-click while riding a sailboat to cycle the sails: full, reefed, furled.
itemdesc-repairkit: Right-click near a sailboat to patch the worse of hull or sails (+25%). Wears out after 24 uses.
itemdesc-bailingbucket: Right-click within 6 blocks of a swamped boat to bail out 30% of the water. Wears out after 40 uses.
itemdesc-recoveryballoon: Right-click within 10 blocks of a capsized or swamped sailboat: balloons haul it upright and refloat it. Single use.
itemdesc-foghorn: Right-click to sound a long blast. Other sailors within 250 blocks are told which way it came from. Essential in fog.
itemdesc-concertina: Right-click aboard or beside a boat to play a sea shanty and lift the crew's morale by 20% (once a minute per boat).
itemdesc-spyglass: Hold right-click to zoom in. Spot wrecks, bottles, land and other boats; fog is thinner through the lens.
itemdesc-treasurechart: Right-click for the bearing and distance to the mark. Stand on it and right-click to dig. Found in bottles and wrecks.
itemdesc-nameplate: Right-click within 6 blocks of a sailboat to give her a new name. Single use.
itemdesc-keel: Fit to a nearby sailboat: less leeway and half the capsize risk. Single use.
itemdesc-sailcloth: Fit to a nearby sailboat: sails wear half as fast and the boat is 5% quicker. Single use.
itemdesc-reinforce: Fit to a nearby sailboat: hull wears and floods half as fast. Single use.
itemdesc-oars: Hold right-click aboard a sailboat to row it where you are looking. Slow, but works in a calm, in fog and against a whirlpool.
itemdesc-towrope: Use beside a boat to make the rope fast, then beside the towing boat to hitch them. Use again beside either to cast off. Parts if stretched too far.
itemdesc-lightningrod: Fit to a nearby sailboat: lightning strikes are carried harmlessly into the sea. Single use.
